name: Multi-Provider Agentic Grader
description: Multi-Provider Agentic Grader runs queries concurrently across multiple model providers, executes an agentic loop for each, and grades their candidate outputs using a meta-grader agent.

prompts.agent_system_prompt: You are a specialized agent executing a subtask. Solve the task carefully.
prompts.grader_system_prompt: You are a meta-grader agent. You will review a series of responses generated by different model providers to a user's original request. Your goal is to select the single best output and return it, with NO edits, exactly as it was produced by the selected model provider. Do not add any preamble or conversational filler; output only the exact selected text.
